children: PEDEVCO acquired ~5,678 net acres in Wyoming's Mowry formation for $5.9 million, expanding its Powder River Basin position.
Acquired ~5,678 net acres in BLM lease sale held Sept 9-10, 2026, for approximately $5.9 million.
Purchase price equates to about $1,045 per net acre and was funded with cash on hand.
Nearly doubles PEDEVCO’s Mowry acreage in the prospect area to ~12,000 net acres.
Leases carry 10-year primary terms and 12.5% royalty, leaving the company 87.5% net revenue interest.
Targets organic-rich Middle Mowry; nearby horizontal wells peaked ~1,400 Boe/d, indicating development potential.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
